facts.text: Baruch's Subotnick Financial Services Center features the Wasserman Trading Floor, a simulated trading environment with 55 workstations accessing real-time market data.

sources.title: Subotnick Financial Services Center - Zicklin School of Business | Baruch College
sources.quote: The centerpiece is the Bert W. and Sandra Wasserman Trading Floor, a fully equipped, simulated trading environment featuring 55 high-end, dual-screen workstations providing access to real-time market data feeds, and financial analytical tools.
